summary: Very steep residential street with houses 12-17 m from the kerb.
reasons: Dwellings 12-17 m away on this side

best_section.where: Bottom of Manchester Terrace at the corner, east kerb

drivers.seclusion: Houses front the kerb along its length; nearest dwellings 12-17 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a few cars parked on both sides; usable but the gradient is extreme.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the street, but dense housing makes a van conspicuous.

sun_shade: Mostly open sealed street; trees shade parts of the east verge.
